title: Coefficient realization equals representative descent
statement: theorem finiteScalarTensorRealizationForCoefficients_eq_representatives (B : Type u₁) [Category.{u + 1} B] [Abelian B] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} B] [MonoidalCategory B] [MonoidalPreadditive B] [SymmetricCategory B] [MonoidalClosed B] [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution B] (T : Scheme.{u}) {H : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} H] {E : Type u₄} [Category.{v₄} E] (q' : H ⥤ E) (F : CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B) ℤ ⥤ H) (LF : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B) ⥤ E) (eps : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ LF ≅ F ⋙ q') (P : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B) ℤ)) (hP : ∀ Q, P Q → (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat Q) (S : ObjectProperty H) (hF : ∀ Q, P Q → S (F.obj Q)) (ff : ((whiskeringLeft (P.FullSubcategory × P.FullSubcategory) (DerivedCategory (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B) × DerivedCategory (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B)) E).obj ((P.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q).prod (P.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q))).FullyFaithful) (t' : H × H ⥤ H) (T' : E × E ⥤ E) (r' : (S.ι.prod S.ι) ⋙ t' ⋙ q' ≅ ((S.ι ⋙ q').prod (S.ι ⋙ q')) ⋙ T') (b : uncurry.obj ((curriedTensor (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B)).map₂HomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ)) ⋙ F ≅ (F.prod F) ⋙ t') : finiteScalarTensorRealizationForCoefficients B T q' F LF eps P hP S hF ff t' T' r' b = finiteScalarTensorRealizationOfRepresentatives DerivedCategory.Q q' F LF eps P S hF ff _ t' (ProEtale.derivedTensor B T) T' (finiteScalarFixedTensorRepresentativeForCoefficients B T P hP) r' b

proof.text: Delta-reduce finiteScalarTensorRealizationForCoefficients. Its body is exactly the displayed finiteScalarTensorRealizationOfRepresentatives with the supplied fixed tensor representative and all the same arguments. Reflexivity proves the equality; no componentwise comparison is necessary.
